description: Use this to get a Formheim price for, or to order, a print of a specific file: a customer's own file or a model you created yourself (STL, OBJ, 3MF; multi-colour is supported). You do not need to send the file yourself: give the customer the file (as a download if you made it) and the upload_url, and they analyse and upload it in their own browser. Preferred way to start a print-offer request. Creates a request and returns upload_url for the customer: they open it, choose their files, adjust settings and upload, in their own browser. No file access or network access is needed on your side. Returns request_id and request_key (keep both private). Pass an existing request_id and request_key to get a new link for a request you already prepared, for example after your own upload failed. After the customer says they have uploaded, poll get_print_request_status; its analysis field is what you pass to get_print_quote and submit_to_offer.
name: create_upload_link
